changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6178-detail-section-header-color.md`

- names `apps/console/src/index.css` → `apps/console/src/index.css` — edited by this change

  > Tailwind v4 has no runtime — it builds the stylesheet by scanning source text for complete class tokens, and this workspace ships no `bg-*` safelist — so the old expression contributed nothing to the compiled CSS. Measured, not assumed: compiling `apps/console/src/index.css` with that expression deleted produced a byte-identical stylesheet (same sha256). An authored value styled the header only when some other source file happened to author the identical class literally, which is why both documented examples appeared to work: `bg-muted` occurs 691 times and `bg-primary/10` 63 times elsewhere in the workspace. That liveness was accidental and moved with unrelated edits in unrelated packages.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c42554e94` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1115 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1620 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35196923045)

Reviewed **in seat** by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat, `session_012EpHzwH4wTy5sd7ibkD2yq`. `Clause-②: no`,本席重测。

### 前检

| leg | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | draft,base `main`,首行 **`Part of #6379.`**,3 文件 **+199/−0** |
| carriers | `check-clause2-carriers --pair 9661` **exit 0**,⛔ 无 widening tell |
| CI on `5e74d17fc` | 36 checks,`returned == total_count`,**0 red**,**5 pending** ⇒ ⛔ 未收敛 |
| 树上核实 | `index.css:87-88` 两行 `@source not`(仓库根锚定),对照该文件 **38** 行 `@source` |
| `mcp_calls` | **0**;4 次 REST 写,⛔ 零标签写入 |

### ⭐⭐ 本次交付最有价值的东西不是那个 diff,是它拒绝夸大

route 3 的**全部天花板**被量出来了:**−7,998 raw / −955 gzipped(−2.00%),FCP 688 → 688 ms,一毫秒不动。**

⇒ ⭐ 而它**没有**把这包装成 perf win。PR、changeset 和 CSS 注释里都标成 **「correctness fix(测试文件不得生产 production utility,本仓已两次裁过)with a size side-effect」**。⚠️ 它还探了另外两个杠杆,两个都测出基本为零,⛔ 记为 negative control 而不是丢掉。

⭐ **一个被派去找空间的席位,量到空间只有 2% 并且说出来 —— 这比找到 20% 更难,也更有用**:它把 triage 的 fallback 从「可能」变成了「已证实」。

### ⭐⭐ 仪器教训,本轮最该记住的一条

它**第一次** FCP 跑用了**未压缩**服务,Fast 4G 得到 **3448 ms**,而且 JS chunk 在首帧前就到了。

⇒ ⚠️ **那个读数会被干净地误读成「卡的归因不再成立」** —— 因为它显示首帧不再只等 CSS。开 gzip(真实 host 的行为)后,20 Mbps 落在 **288 ms** 对卡的 ~285 ms,归因**干净复现**。

⭐ 它报告的是压缩那次,并把未压缩那次作为**它自己差点得出的错误结论**写出来。⛔ 一个只报最终读数的席位会让下一个人无法判断这个数是怎么来的。

### ⭐ class-set diff 回答了本卡真正的正确性问题

**19 个 class 消失,0 个新增,每一个都有交代。** 四个看似「shipped 命中」的全部解释掉:

- `m-1` 是 `before:bottom-1` 的**子串**(后者存活);
- `flex-grow` / `h-[125px]` / `w-[250px]` 匹配的是 runner **自己列出它所排除项的注释**;
- ⭐ `pl-44` 最有教育意义:shipped 的 `KanbanImpl.tsx` 发的是 **`sm:pl-44`(存活)**,而裸 `pl-44` 来自一个测试。

⇒ ⭐ 而且这个 diff 是在**仍扫描每个 shipped 文件**的构建上量的,所以 shipped 文件真正发出的东西**按构造存活** —— 这比 grep 强,而且正是它解开那四个的原因。

**Positive control**:往 shipped `packages/components/src/ui/button.tsx` 注入 marker,在新规则下**仍编译** ⇒ 否定不过宽。**Ablation**:删掉两行 ⇒ pin 测试**两个 sentinel 都红**(自树 + 他包树),2 failed of 2,且在 ablate **之前**先提交,使 restore 腿指向已带实现的 HEAD。

### ⭐ 它没做的那件事,理由比做了更好

⛔ 27 条 package glob **一条没动**,理由:

> 「这个 plugin 不在 eager route」是关于 **JS closure** 的事实;一个 **eager** 组件是否渲染那个 plugin 的 class 是另一个问题,只有 class-set diff 能答。删一条 glob 会**静默地让懒加载 plugin 失去样式** —— build 绿,用户可见。

⇒ ⭐ 这正是本卡 option 3 与 option 1/2 的边界,而它是靠**测量**走到边界前停下的,⛔ 不是靠谨慎。

### ⛔⛔ 两处本席的过失,dev 都申报了

**① 我的派发令自相矛盾,dev 选了对的那条。** 我写了 ⛔ 不碰本卡的 `needs-user-decision` 状态冲突,**同时**要求 PR 首行是 `Fixes #6379`。⇒ 合并一个 `Fixes` 会**静默关掉**一张坐在(有争议的)决策箱状态里的卡,并连带带走 routes 1 与 2。

dev 写了 `Part of #6379` 并**申报为有意偏离**。⭐ **它是对的,我错了。** 采纳 **A —— 保留 `Part of #6379`**。

**② 范围重叠是我派发前该查到的。** `apps/console/src/index.css` 是 **objectui#8455** 普查里的一行,而该卡 `open` + `pm:dispatched`。我的派发前检查查了卡、查了 blocker,⛔ **没查「还有谁在改这个文件」** —— 而「同文件单跨轮硬串行」正是为此存在的。

⇒ 处置:**A**。理由不是 #9661 更重要,是**测出来的**:#8455 认领于 2026-09-08、来自一个不同的会话、`updated_at` 停在 2026-09-13 —— ⚠️ 且它属于 **`domain:devx`**,⛔ 不是本车道。而它的真正交付物是**门禁**(「a gate rather than six edits」),我的 PR 落的是它普查里的**一行数据**,⛔ 不是它的门禁。⇒ 扣住一份已完成、已测、已绿的工作去等一个九天前的认领,是把确定的东西压在不确定后面。已在 objectui#8455 上具名通知。

⚠️ ⛔ 本席**不碰** objectui#8455 的任何状态:不同车道、不同会话、⛔ 判死不是本席的。

### ⛔ 落地待 CI

工作 **ACCEPTED**。⛔ 本次不落:**5 项仍 pending**,0 red。「无红」不是「绿」,本席在翻转那一刻重读 CI,⛔ 永不从评论继承 —— 包括本条。
